summary.en: Browser Connect Four: play a friend or take on the built-in computer AI.
summary.zh: 四子棋（Connect Four），支持双人对战与电脑 AI。

description.en: Take turns dropping discs from the top; each one falls to the lowest open slot in its column. First to line up four in any direction — across, down or diagonal — wins.
description.zh: 轮流从顶部投子，棋子落到该列最底部。先在横、竖、斜任意方向连成四子者获胜。

howto.en: Mouse — click a column to drop your disc.

tip.en: A zero-dependency Canvas build whose AI logic is easy to swap out for something stronger. Bolt on WebSocket and it becomes online versus play — a low-cost springboard from single-player to multiplayer.
tip.zh: 零依赖 Canvas 实现，AI 逻辑可单独换强。接 WebSocket 就能升级成在线对战，是从单机走向联机的低成本跳板。
